_source: Built from Firecrawl's Search endpoint reference and OpenAPI operation (https://docs.firecrawl.dev/api-reference/endpoint/search), Search guide (https://docs.firecrawl.dev/features/search) and error catalog (https://docs.firecrawl.dev/api-reference/errors). The success body follows the documented reply schema and the guide's web example (title, description, url, position) with the top-level success, data, warning, id and creditsUsed fields; its titles, descriptions and id are illustrative. The empty body leaves data.web out, as Firecrawl's open-source server does when a source finds nothing; empty_array is the other form a reply with no results could take. The malformed body puts results in a bare data array instead of a data object. Error bodies use the documented {success: false, error} shape with the catalog's typical error strings; the 408 and 500 values are the endpoint schema's own examples. The 429 Retry-After header is documented in seconds, sent when available.
